artifacts.summary: Three-phase plan implementing the research's Decision 5 alone: a named cross-record decision-citation convention in report-format.md pointed at from summary-format.md and plan-format.md, a recognized-optional Decisions heading for plans with the documentation-only mirror in validate-artifact.sh, and a redeploy plus full gate run.

memory_candidates.content: Before documenting a new REQUIRED section in one of this system's artifact-format standards (context/formats/{report,plan,summary}-format.md), check scripts/validate-artifact.sh's matching {REPORT,PLAN,SUMMARY}_SECTIONS array: those arrays drive a hard `log_error "Missing required section"` at gate-out, so promoting a section to required retroactively fails every existing artifact that lacks it. The sanctioned landing for a new convention is the recognized-optional tier, whose in-script precedent is the documentation-only SUMMARY_SECTIONS_OPTIONAL array (carrying `# shellcheck disable=SC2034`, deliberately never wired into required_sections) -- an anti-drift mirror of the standard's own optional-section list that changes no validation behavior.
